{{Top|leg}}
The '''Droid ejection system''' was standard equipment aboard [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]] that allowed the [[Astromech droid/Legends|Astromech droid]] to be saved in the event that the ship was destroyed. Around [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], this system needed to be enabled by the pilot prior to activation.
